description_en: Queries the run history of data quality scans in a specified project
description_zh: 查询指定项目下的数据质量扫描运行记录
name: ListDataQualityScanRuns

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data quality scan
parameters.name: data_quality_scan_id

parameters.help_en: The earliest start time of a data quality scan run to include in the results. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 数据质量监控运行最早开始时间
parameters.name: create_time_from

parameters.help_en: The latest start time of a data quality scan run to include in the results. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 数据质量监控运行最晚开始时间
parameters.name: create_time_to

parameters.help_en:
The status of the data quality scan run. Valid values:

Pass

Running

Error

Fail

Warn
parameters.help_zh:
数据质量校验结果状态。
Pass
Running
Error
Fail
Warn
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sort field and order for the results. The format is `FieldName Order`. The default order is ascending (Asc). Supported fields:

CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

Id (Desc/Asc)
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段列表，支持修改时间、创建时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（默认Asc，可以省略）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
Id (Desc/Asc)
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 列表翻页查询页大小，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表翻页查询页码，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
An object with advanced filter conditions. The following parameters are supported:

`TaskInstanceId`: The ID of the task instance.

`RunNumber`: The run number of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
扩展的查询Filter，目前支持以下过滤参数：
TaskInstanceId  调度任务实例ID
RunNumber          实例运行次数
parameters.name: filter

items.description_zh: 数据质量监控运行记录列表
